title: Wahoo Engine Data and Procurement Roadmap

stages.title: 1. Requirements
stages.dataNeeded: Rider/board mass range, speed and acceleration goals, runtime, duty cycle, fuel, mass/budget limits and service access
stages.source: Max’s requirements; hull and propulsion chapters; weighed components; inner-hull and hatch measurements
stages.unlocks: A design brief and target operating envelope
stages.currentEvidence: Targets, duty cycle and usable inner hull still need a controlled brief.
stages.nextAction: Record the board and engine target envelope.
stages.evidenceRequired: Source document or measurement with units, part/revision, date, uncertainty and a recorded review.

stages.title: 2. Reference interfaces
stages.dataNeeded: Piston crown/height/ring pins/clearance; crank journals/webs/ends/bearings; pump shaft, coupling and torque-versus-rpm load
stages.source: Wössner drawings and clearance instructions; verified sample parts and metrology; pump supplier data or instrumented pump test
stages.unlocks: Physical datums, cylinder compatibility, crankcase interfaces and approximate power demand
stages.currentEvidence: Piston/crank references selected, not purchased; full interfaces and pump curve are missing.
stages.nextAction: Obtain pump torque/power-versus-RPM curve and piston/crank installation drawings.
stages.evidenceRequired: Source document or measurement with units, part/revision, date, uncertainty and a recorded review.

stages.title: 3. Engine baseline
stages.dataNeeded: Donor/adapted versus custom cylinder; port heights/widths/angles and timing, transfer passages, exhaust outlet direction, piston-to-port clearance; head squish/chamber volume; reed/intake layout; crankcase volume, lubrication and mechanical design
stages.source: Explicit design choices; matching-year Yamaha manual as an OEM reference; measured donor cylinder/head; engine designer; piston/crank drawings and samples
stages.unlocks: A dimensioned engine specification for prediction and CAD
stages.currentEvidence: Nominal kinematics exist; cylinder, ports and head are not defined.
stages.nextAction: Choose a measured donor cylinder/head benchmark or a deliberately designed custom baseline.
stages.evidenceRequired: Source document or measurement with units, part/revision, date, uncertainty and a recorded review.

stages.title: 4. Predict loads
stages.dataNeeded: Torque/power curve, airflow, fuel demand, injection window, pumping/scavenging losses, heat rejection and starting torque estimate
stages.source: Kinematic and gas-dynamic models; pump load curve; benchmark test data; bounded fuel-consumption and thermal assumptions
stages.unlocks: Provisional component sizes with margins and stated uncertainty
stages.currentEvidence: Power/RPM references remain provisional; verified pump load is missing.
stages.nextAction: Calculate bounded loads from the controlled engine and pump inputs.
stages.evidenceRequired: Source document or measurement with units, part/revision, date, uncertainty and a recorded review.

stages.title: 5A. Exhaust
stages.dataNeeded: Port area/duration, target power band, gas-temperature range, outlet flange and straight aft space
stages.source: Step 3 engine specification; Step 4 models; hull measurements; later thermocouple/dyno data
stages.unlocks: Engine-matched pipe design, fabrication drawings and water/heat protection layout
stages.currentEvidence: Straight internal-stinger direction recorded; dimensions and tuning unqualified.
stages.nextAction: Match the straight pipe to engine port, speed and thermal data.
stages.evidenceRequired: Source document or measurement with units, part/revision, date, uncertainty and a recorded review.

stages.title: 5B. EFI
stages.dataNeeded: Injector flow, spray and dead-time data; throttle bore/TPS/mount; pump delivery curve; regulator range/reference; filters, rail, hoses and return
stages.source: Bosch exact-part datasheet/bench test; EcoEFI or other supplier drawings/curves; Steps 3–4 fuel/air requirements
stages.unlocks: Exact injector, throttle body, pump and regulator candidates and fuel-system BOM
stages.currentEvidence: EFI shortlist recorded; exact variants and compatibility unresolved.
stages.nextAction: Confirm exact injector/TB/pump/regulator drawings, curves and driver interfaces.
stages.evidenceRequired: Source document or measurement with units, part/revision, date, uncertainty and a recorded review.

stages.title: 5C. Supporting systems
stages.dataNeeded: Cranking speed/peak torque, motor/reduction/freewheel; flywheel inertia/trigger; battery voltage and peak/continuous loads; cooling flow/pressure, jackets and oil strategy
stages.source: Initial compression/friction estimates; motor/controller curves; later unfired crank torque test; electrical and cooling chapters; coolant/pump measurements
stages.unlocks: Starter/drive, flywheel, power system, cooling and lubrication selections
stages.currentEvidence: Starter position retained; voltage, torque, drive and cooling data unresolved.
stages.nextAction: Resolve voltage/current budget, starter drive, cooling and lubrication inputs.
stages.evidenceRequired: Source document or measurement with units, part/revision, date, uncertainty and a recorded review.

stages.title: 6. Integration
stages.dataNeeded: Actual part envelopes, stack-ups/fits, ring/port clearance, mounts, coupling loads, inner hull/hatch clearance, tank removal, mass/CG, heat and water exposure
stages.source: Supplier CAD; measured parts; Rhino assembly; structural/thermal checks; physical mock-up
stages.unlocks: Prototype machining drawings and a reviewed purchase list
stages.currentEvidence: Rev06 layout accepted; extraction, interior clearances and mass/CG unverified.
stages.nextAction: Verify inner hull, assembly stack-ups and the tank extraction sweep.
stages.evidenceRequired: Source document or measurement with units, part/revision, date, uncertainty and a recorded review.

stages.title: 7. Test and calibrate
stages.dataNeeded: Actual compression/leakage, torque/power/fuel use, fuel pressure, injector behavior, temperatures, cooling, starting current and vibration
stages.source: Instrumented engine bench/dyno; ECU logs; metrology; pump-load and subsequent controlled installed-system tests
stages.unlocks: Corrected fuel/ignition/injection maps, validated hardware and model parameters
stages.currentEvidence: No accepted engine-dyno results or calibrated map recorded.
stages.nextAction: Arrange instrumentation and appropriate engine-dyno commissioning.
stages.evidenceRequired: Source document or measurement with units, part/revision, date, uncertainty and a recorded review.

stages.title: 8. Release
stages.dataNeeded: Final part numbers, materials/tolerances, suppliers, fabrication/assembly steps, service procedures and accepted operating limits
stages.source: Verified Step 6 drawings plus Step 7 test evidence
stages.unlocks: Build/buy package and a digital twin with a stated validated range
stages.currentEvidence: Final operating limits and production part list not released.
stages.nextAction: Release only against accepted drawings and test evidence.
stages.evidenceRequired: Source document or measurement with units, part/revision, date, uncertainty and a recorded review.

purchaseGates.title: Reference hardware
purchaseGates.scope: One verified piston kit, selected crank assembly or measured donor top end
purchaseGates.evidence: Exact identity, compatibility review, dimensions plan and budget; parts purchased to unlock geometry, not a full-system approval

purchaseGates.title: Development hardware
purchaseGates.scope: Adjustable bench fuel system, candidate injector/TB, ECU and instrumentation
purchaseGates.evidence: Provisional load/pressure/voltage ranges, driver compatibility, sizing margins and current drawings; configure final part choices after tests

purchaseGates.title: Custom prototype
purchaseGates.scope: Cylinder, head, crankcase, pipe, mounts and coupling
purchaseGates.evidence: Reviewed geometry, materials/fits, port/ring checks, supplier instructions and assembly/tolerance review

purchaseGates.title: Production system
purchaseGates.evidence: Accepted tests and frozen part numbers, drawings, calibration and operating limits
